📺 Chicago Fire (2012–Present)

Chicago Fire follows the courageous firefighters, rescue squad members, and paramedics of Firehouse 51 as they risk their lives protecting the people of Chicago. Led by dedicated professionals like Kelly Severide and Matthew Casey, the team faces dangerous fires, devastating accidents, and life-threatening emergencies that test their bravery and teamwork. Beyond the firehouse, they navigate complicated relationships, personal struggles, friendships, and heartbreaking losses. As they confront new challenges both on and off duty, their loyalty to one another becomes their greatest strength. Filled with intense rescues, emotional moments, and unforgettable characters, Chicago Fire celebrates courage, sacrifice, friendship, and the extraordinary dedication of first responders.

🎭 Genre: Action • Drama • Emergency Services

⭐ IMDb: 8.0/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 42 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creators: Michael Brandt & Derek Haas

📺 Where to Watch: Peacock in the United States. Availability varies by region.
